network_status.network: Laino Castello, crollato il ponte in località San Liguori a causa del maltempo
network_status.summary_it: La fonte identifica il cedimento del ponte in località San Liguori durante il maltempo, ma non pubblica livello, portata o stazione sul Paraturo. ARCUS mantiene l’evidenza descrittiva senza attribuire valori al corso d’acqua.
network_status.summary_en: The source identifies failure of the San Liguori bridge during severe weather but publishes no Paraturo stage, discharge or station. ARCUS retains the descriptive evidence without assigning values to the watercourse.

caveats: The cited source review is complete; no compatible tabulated bridge-section value is assigned.
ARCUS does not digitise plotted hydrographs into false-precision event peaks.

Rainfall is not converted into stage or discharge.
